东侧台阶上到瀑布顶（约 60 m 高差），再往上游走，第一座 Hestavaðs: Up the east-side stairs to the top of the falls (about 60 m of climbing), then upstream: Hestavaðsfoss is about 200 m in, Fosstorfufoss about 600 m; a 1–2 h round trip takes in 4–6 waterfalls
停车场走 15–25 分钟到冰川前缘。: 15–25 min walk from the parking lot to the glacier edge.
停车场到冰川前缘约 0.8–1.2 km，15–25 分钟；没有向导不要踏上冰面: About 0.8–1.2 km from the parking lot to the glacier edge, 15–25 min; don't step onto the ice without a guide
冰川退得很快，前缘的冰湖和冰崖很危险，只站在观景点看；想上冰面就报向导团。: The glacier is retreating fast and the lagoon and ice cliffs at its edge are dangerous, so stay at the viewpoint; to get on the ice, join a guided tour.
1 号 → 218 号（上灯塔一段陡坡砾石路），约 25 km: Route 1 → Route 218 (a steep gravel stretch up to the lighthouse), about 25 km
海蚀拱门、灯塔，7 月初正是海鹦季。: Sea arch and lighthouse; early July is peak puffin season.
5/1–6/25 期间政府可以限制进入；常见做法是上层灯塔区 19:00–09:: From May 1 to Jun 25 the government can restrict access; usually the upper lighthouse area is closed 19:00–09:00. Jul 8 is after the restriction period
约 4 月底到 8 月中在崖上筑巢，7 月初正是观赏期: Nest on the cliffs from about late April to mid-August; early July is prime viewing time
上灯塔的一段陡而窄，是砾石路；夏天两驱车也能开: The climb to the lighthouse is steep, narrow gravel; fine for 2WD in summer
上层灯塔区看拱门和海鹦，下层看 Reynisdrangar 方向；风大时注意手机: Go to the upper lighthouse area for the arch and puffins, and the lower area for views toward Reynisdrangar; hold on to phones and hats when it's windy.
[[reynisfjara]]：玄武岩柱和海蚀柱 Reynisdrangar: [[reynisfjara]]: basalt columns and the Reynisdrangar sea stacks
玄武岩柱、黑沙滩和海里的 Reynisdrangar 海蚀柱。**疯狗浪会死人*: Basalt columns, black sand and the Reynisdrangar sea stacks offshore. **Sneaker waves kill people**: check the warning lights at the entrance.
入口处有绿/黄/红灯：绿 = 风险低；黄 = 不要进入黄区，远离水线；红 = 禁: Green/yellow/red lights at the entrance: green = low risk; yellow = stay out of the yellow zone and away from the waterline; red = no access to the beach
2025 年 8 月一名 9 岁儿童遇难后，红灯触发门槛调低；红灯时在观景台关闸: After a 9-year-old died in August 2025, the red-light threshold was lowered; on red, the gate at the viewpoint is closed and the basalt columns and Hálsanefshellir cave are off-limits
任何时候都不要背对大海，与水线保持 30 m 以上距离；红灯时只在观景台看。: Never turn your back on the sea, and stay at least 30 m from the waterline; on red, only look from the viewpoint.
维克住宿少、贵，7 月要至少提前半年订。: Vík has few places to stay and they're pricey; book at least 6 months ahead for July.
沿 1 号公路开过[[eldhraun]]，看[[fjadrargljufur]: Drive Route 1 across [[eldhraun]], see [[fjadrargljufur]] and [[svinafellsjokull]], hike [[mulagljufur]], then in the evening stop at [[fjallsarlon]], [[jokulsarlon]] and [[diamond_beach]] on the way; overnight at [[smyrlabjorg]].
1783 年 Laki 火山喷发留下的熔岩，上面盖满厚厚的绿苔。: Lava from the 1783 Laki eruption, now covered in thick green moss.
苔藓极其脆弱，法律禁止踩踏；只能在指定停靠点和步道上看: The moss is extremely fragile and walking on it is illegal; only look from marked pull-outs and trails
1 号 → 206 号，约 3 km 砾石路: Route 1 → Route 206, about 3 km of gravel
沿峡谷边缘走到尽头的观景台，峡谷像羽毛一样蜿蜒。: Walk along the canyon rim to the viewpoint at the end; the canyon winds like a feather.
沿峡谷边缘往返约 2–3 km，45–60 分钟: About 2–3 km round trip along the rim, 45–60 min
过去曾在春季因植被受损临时关闭；2026 年无限制报道: It has closed temporarily in spring in the past because of vegetation damage; no restrictions reported for 2026
经 Kirkjubæjarklaustur（可加油、买午饭），约 80 km: Via Kirkjubæjarklaustur (gas and lunch), about 80 km
近距离看冰舌和冰川湖。: Get close to the glacier tongue and its lagoon.
自 2018 年起，因 Svínafellsheiði 山体裂缝有滑坡风险，冰川: Since 2018, glacier hiking tours here have been suspended indefinitely because a crack in Svínafellsheiði mountain poses a landslide risk; Civil Protection advises only brief stops at the glacier viewpoint
出发前查 safetravel.is：如有新的滑坡警告，就别去了，改去 Skaf: Check safetravel.is before you go: if there's a new landslide warning, skip it and go to Svartifoss in Skaftafell instead (S2 loop, about 5.8 km, 2 h).
1 号公路约 41 km，最后约 1.5 km 砾石便道: About 41 km on Route 1, with the last 1.5 km or so on a gravel track
峡谷深处有两条瀑布，尽头能远眺冰川。**天气不好别去。**: Two waterfalls deep in the canyon, with glacier views at the end. **Skip it in bad weather.**
1–7 座 1,000 ISK/4 小时（Parka 7203 区）；停不到 1: 1–7 seats 1,000 ISK/4 h (Parka zone 7203); under 10 min free
单程约 3.5–3.8 km，35–60 分钟，往返 2–3 小时；爬升约 19: About 3.5–3.8 km one way, 35–60 min, 2–3 h round trip; about 190 m of climbing
简单到中等：小路窄，有碎石，过两条小溪，最后一段是陡坡: Easy to moderate: narrow path with loose gravel, two stream crossings, steep final section
带防水登山鞋；冰川融水让第二条小溪在下午变深。: Wear waterproof hiking boots; glacial melt makes the second stream deeper in the afternoon.
比冰河湖人少，冰川离得更近。: Quieter than Jökulsárlón, with the glacier much closer.
1–7 座 1,000 ISK/4 小时（Parka 7204 区），停不到 1: 1–7 seats 1,000 ISK/4 h (Parka zone 7204); under 10 min free
要在 4 小时内付款，否则加收 1,960 ISK: Pay within 4 h or there's an extra 1,960 ISK charge
比 Jökulsárlón 人少，冰川离得更近；从停车场步行约 5 分钟上湖岸。: Fewer people than Jökulsárlón and the glacier is closer; about a 5 min walk from the parking lot to the shore.
冰川崩下来的蓝色浮冰漂在湖里，有时能看到海豹。傍晚人比白天少，光线也好（日落约: Blue icebergs calved from the glacier float in the lagoon, and sometimes there are seals. Evenings are quieter than daytime with better light (sunset around 23:15).
A 类私家车 1,110 ISK，当天午夜前有效，可随时进出（Parka 或现场: Category A private cars 1,110 ISK, valid until midnight that day, come and go as you like (Parka or pay machine on site)
Jökulsárlón 和东、西两段 Fellsfjara（钻石沙滩）属于同一收: Jökulsárlón and the east and west parts of Fellsfjara (Diamond Beach) are one parking zone
同一天已在 Skaftafell 付过全价，这里打五折（反之亦然），须用同一种付: If you've already paid full price at Skaftafell the same day, it's half price here (and vice versa); you must use the same payment method
浮冰被冲上黑沙滩，像散落的钻石。: Chunks of ice washed up on the black sand like scattered diamonds.
已含在 Jökulsárlón 的停车费里: Included in the Jökulsárlón parking fee
酒店餐厅约 20:30 关门，晚饭可能来不及：在 Kirkjubæjarklau: The hotel restaurant closes around 20:30, so you may miss dinner: buy food in Kirkjubæjarklaustur or Höfn, or call ahead.
上午从[[hali]]跟团冰川徒步，下午去[[stokksnes]]，住[[ho: Guided glacier hike from [[hali]] in the morning, [[stokksnes]] in the afternoon; overnight in [[hofn]].
冰河湖昨晚已经看过，今天不用往回开，可以睡个懒觉。: You already saw Jökulsárlón last night, so no need to drive back; sleep in.
从[[hali]]出发的向导团，穿冰爪上 Breiðamerkurjökull: Guided tour from [[hali]]: put on crampons and head up Breiðamerkurjökull. Meeting time depends on the slot you book; planned here as a morning tour.
成人 15,500 ISK，10–12 岁 9,900 ISK；最低 10 岁；: Adults 15,500 ISK, ages 10–12 9,900 ISK; minimum age 10; 3.5–4 h total (1–1.5 h on the ice); several departures daily May–Sep
Blue Ice Discovery 3.5 小时约 US$116–149，最低: Blue Ice Discovery 3.5 h about US$116–149, minimum age 10; Glacier Adventure 4.5 h about US$160, minimum age 14
7/10 住在东边，冰川徒步选 Hali 出发的 Breiðamerkurjök: Since you're staying east on Jul 10, a Breiðamerkurjökull tour from Hali is the most convenient; Skaftafell tours mean backtracking west about 1 h. Or do the hike when passing Skaftafell on Jul 9.
要穿防水登山鞋（冰爪要绑在鞋上），7 月就该订。: Wear waterproof hiking boots (the crampons strap onto them). Book now for July.
冰川徒步集合点旁边的餐厅和小博物馆。: Restaurant and small museum next to the glacier hike meeting point.
1 号公路过 Höfn 路口，再走约 5 km 砾石路到 Viking Café: Route 1 past the Höfn turnoff, then about 5 km of gravel to the Viking Café; about 61 km
黑沙丘和草丛后面是锯齿状的 Vestrahorn 山。: Jagged Vestrahorn rises behind black dunes and tufts of grass.
约 1,000 ISK/人（2024–2026 多个来源；有一处说 2026 年: About 1,000 ISK/person (several sources, 2024–2026; one says 1,100 ISK in 2026); free under 16
Viking Café 店内；打烊后有自助售票机: Inside the Viking Café; self-service ticket machine after closing
沙滩、步道、维京村布景和厕所: Beach, trails, the Viking village film set and toilets
Vestrahorn 的倒影要在退潮、无风时拍，可以看潮汐表挑时间。: For Vestrahorn's reflection, shoot at low tide with no wind; check a tide table to pick your time.
霍芬以龙虾（海螯虾）出名，可以奖励自己一顿。: Höfn is famous for langoustine; treat yourself.
沿 1 号公路穿过东部峡湾，下午翻山去塞济斯菲厄泽，晚上住埃伊尔斯塔济。: Follow Route 1 through the East Fjords, cross the mountains to Seyðisfjörður in the afternoon, and stay the night in Egilsstaðir.
民宿或青旅，约 20,000–35,000 ISK/间（青旅床位约 8,000–: Guesthouse or hostel, about 20,000–35,000 ISK/room (hostel beds about 8,000–11,000 ISK/person)
在 N1 加满油，Nettó 补点午餐。东部峡湾一带加油站不多。: Fill the tank at N1 and grab lunch supplies at Nettó. Gas stations are few and far between in the East Fjords.
1 号公路往东北，过 Almannaskarð 隧道: Route 1 northeast, through the Almannaskarð tunnel
橙色小灯塔在一道长长的砾石沙洲上，背后是 Eystrahorn 山，天气好时跟: A little orange lighthouse on a long gravel spit, with Eystrahorn behind it. On a clear day it's as photogenic as Vestrahorn, but almost empty.
路边有小停车区，海边风很大，注意帽子。: Small roadside pull-out; it's very windy by the sea, so hold on to your hat.
海边码头旁一排 34 颗花岗岩鸟蛋雕塑，每颗对应当地一种鸟。小镇是慢城 (Cit: A row of 34 granite egg sculptures along the harbor, one for each local bird species. The village is a Cittaslow town, so grab a coffee by the harbor.
1 号公路沿海经 Breiðdalsvík: Route 1 along the coast via Breiðdalsvík
一位当地老奶奶 Petra 花一辈子在东部山里捡的石头和矿物，堆满了房子和花园。: A lifetime of rocks and minerals collected in the eastern mountains by a local woman, Petra, filling her house and garden. You can picnic in the yard.
镇上有 Bónus 和 Nettó，是去米湖前最后一个大超市。买够两天的早餐和午: The town has Bónus and Nettó, the last big supermarkets before Mývatn. Buy two days' worth of breakfast and lunch.
93 号公路翻越 Fjarðarheiði 山口（约 620 m，夏天也可能有雪: Route 93 over the Fjarðarheiði pass (about 620 m; snow walls and fog possible even in summer)
下山快到镇上时路边的一道瀑布，停车 10 分钟就够。: A waterfall right by the road as you come down toward town; a 10-minute stop is plenty.
逛彩虹街和蓝色教堂: Rainbow Street and the blue church
峡湾尽头的小镇：彩虹石板路尽头是浅蓝色木教堂，周围是彩色木屋和瀑布。可以沿 Bú: A little town at the head of the fjord: the rainbow-painted street leads to a pale blue wooden church, surrounded by colorful wooden houses and waterfalls. Walk a short way up the Búðará river to see the falls, then have dinner.
这是诺罗纳号渡轮 (Norröna) 停靠的港口，周四船来时人会多。: This is where the Norröna ferry docks, so it gets busy on Thursdays when the ship is in.
93 号公路原路翻山回去: Back over the mountain on Route 93
入住民宿或青旅；选带厨房的，可以自己做饭省钱。: Check in at the guesthouse or hostel; pick one with a kitchen so you can cook and save money.
上午徒步去看蓝绿色河水和玄武岩柱，下午看欧洲水量最大的瀑布之一，晚上泡米湖温泉。: Morning hike to see turquoise water and basalt columns, afternoon at one of Europe's most powerful waterfalls, evening soak at the Mývatn baths.
早点出发，Stuðlagil 上午人少、光线好。: Leave early: Stuðlagil is quieter with better light in the morning.
1 号公路 → 923 号公路 (Jökuldalsvegur)，最后一段过 K: Route 1 → Route 923 (Jökuldalsvegur); the last stretch crosses the Klaustursel bridge onto a gravel road to the east-side parking lot, no problem for a 4x4
从东岸停车场沿河走，路过 Stuðlafoss 瀑布（也是玄武岩柱），然后下到峡: Follow the river from the east-side parking lot past Stuðlafoss (also framed by basalt columns), then down to the river at the canyon floor for a close look at the hexagonal columns.
往返约 5 km（较远的停车场约 10 km）: About 5 km round trip (about 10 km from the farther parking lot)
易–中，最后下河边的一段有陡坡: Easy to moderate; steep at the end where you go down to the river
西岸 (Grund) 只有观景台和楼梯，下不到谷底，所以去东岸。: The west side (Grund) only has a viewing platform and stairs and you can't get down into the canyon, so go to the east side.
河水在 8 月以后可能被上游水库放水变浑，7 月中一般还是蓝绿色。: From August, water released from the upstream reservoir can turn the river murky; in mid-July it's usually still turquoise.
回到 1 号公路往西，进入 Möðrudalsöræfi 高原荒漠: Back on Route 1 heading west, into the Möðrudalsöræfi highland desert
冰岛海拔最高的农场，草皮屋顶的咖啡馆，有羊肉汤和自制面包。也可以在车上吃自带午餐: Iceland's highest farm, with a turf-roofed café serving lamb soup and homemade bread. Or eat your packed lunch in the car.
1 号公路 → 862 号公路（柏油路）北上到西岸停车场: Route 1 → Route 862 (paved) north to the west-side parking lot
Dettifoss 落差 44 m、宽 100 m，灰色的冰川水轰鸣而下。从停车: Dettifoss drops 44 m and is 100 m wide, a roar of grey glacial water. Walk from the parking lot to the falls, then about 1 km upstream along the river to Selfoss.
水雾很大，穿防水外套。: Lots of spray; wear a waterproof jacket.
西岸路好、观景点多；东岸 864 号是碎石路。: The west side has the better road and more viewpoints; Road 864 on the east side is gravel.
火星一样的橙色地热区，冒泡的泥浆池和呼呼作响的喷气孔，硫磺味很重。: A Mars-like orange geothermal field with bubbling mud pots and hissing steam vents; strong sulfur smell.
只走围绳以内的步道，地面可能是烫的薄壳。: Stay on the roped paths: the ground can be a thin, scalding crust.
北方版蓝湖：比蓝湖便宜、人少，乳蓝色的地热水，可以看到湖景。夏天开到很晚。: The north's answer to the Blue Lagoon: cheaper and quieter, with milky-blue geothermal water and lake views. Open late in summer.
成人约 6,500 ISK，学生约 4,300 ISK（2026 年参考价，需核: Adults about 6,500 ISK, students about 4,300 ISK (2026 reference prices, to be confirmed)
官网提前 1–3 天订: Book on the official site 1–3 days ahead
近年改名或扩建为 Earth Lagoon Mývatn，订票时以官网为准。: Recently renamed/expanded as Earth Lagoon Mývatn; check the official site when booking.
火口湖、还在冒烟的熔岩、爬火山口、熔岩迷宫和假火山口，下午众神瀑布，晚上到北部首: Crater lake, still-steaming lava, a crater climb, a lava maze and pseudocraters; Goðafoss in the afternoon, then on to the capital of the north for the night.
早上先去最远的克拉夫拉。: Start the morning with Krafla, the farthest stop.
1 号公路往东 → 863 号公路，经过地热电站: Route 1 east → Route 863, past the geothermal power station
Víti 在冰岛语里是「地狱」，1724 年爆发后留下的火口湖，可沿口沿走一段。: Víti means "hell" in Icelandic: a crater lake left by the 1724 eruption. You can walk part of the rim.
863 号公路尽头的停车场: Parking lot at the end of Route 863
1975–84 年「克拉夫拉之火」喷出的黑色熔岩，局部仍在冒蒸汽，旁边是彩色的硫: Black lava from the 1975–84 "Krafla Fires", still steaming in places, next to colorful sulfur hills.
只走木栈道和标记步道。: Stay on the boardwalks and marked trails.
回 1 号公路，绕到湖东侧: Back to Route 1, around to the east side of the lake
爬火山口、绕口沿走: Climbing the crater and walking the rim
约 2,500 年前形成的巨大碗状火山口，直径约 1 km。爬上去约 20 分钟: A huge bowl-shaped crater formed about 2,500 years ago, roughly 1 km across. About 20 min up; the rim loop is about 3 km with views over all of Mývatn.
钻进地下温泉洞: Into the underground hot spring cave
地裂缝里的蓝色温泉洞，《权力的游戏》取景地。现在水温太高，禁止下水。: A blue hot spring in a cave in the rift, a Game of Thrones filming location. The water is too hot now and bathing is banned.
熔岩湖排空后留下的高大熔岩柱和拱洞，传说是冰岛 13 个圣诞小精灵的家。走「教堂: Tall lava pillars and arches left when a lava lake drained; legend says it's home to Iceland's 13 Yule Lads. Walk the Church Circle (Kirkjuhringur); there's a café at the entrance.
848 号公路沿湖南岸: Route 848 along the south shore of the lake
熔岩流到湿地上、水汽爆炸形成的一个个小火山口，旁边是湖和鸟。: Little craters formed by steam explosions when lava flowed over wetland, next to the lake and its birds.
公元 1000 年冰岛皈依基督教，传说议长把异教神像扔进了这道马蹄形瀑布。东西两: When Iceland converted to Christianity in the year 1000, legend says the lawspeaker threw his pagan idols into this horseshoe-shaped waterfall. There are trails on both banks; on the west side you can get down to the water.
1 号公路，经 Vaðlaheiðargöng 隧道（收费，需在 veggjal: Route 1 through the Vaðlaheiðargöng tunnel (toll, pay online at veggjald.is); to avoid the toll take the old Víkurskarð road, about 15 min longer
爬上阿克雷里教堂前的台阶看峡湾，逛免费的 Lystigarður 植物园，看看主: Climb the steps up to Akureyri Church for fjord views, wander the free Lystigarður botanical garden, and spot the heart-shaped red traffic lights on the main street.
步行或开车回住处: Walk or drive back to where you're staying
一路往西开 400 多公里：草皮屋、白色巨人海蚀柱，傍晚到草帽山。: Over 400 km west: turf houses, the Hvítserkur sea stack, and Kirkjufell by early evening.
加满油，Bónus 补给。: Fill up the tank and restock at Bónus.
18–19 世纪的草皮农舍群，现在是博物馆，能看到当年冰岛人怎么过冬。: A cluster of 18th–19th-century turf farmhouses, now a museum showing how Icelanders got through the winter.
约 2,500 ISK（只看外观免费）: About 2,500 ISK (free to see from outside)
1 号公路往西 → Víðidalur 转 716/711 号碎石路约 30 k: Route 1 west → turn at Víðidalur onto gravel roads 716/711, about 30 km
15 m 高的玄武岩海蚀柱，像一头低头喝水的犀牛或恐龙。可以走小路下到沙滩，退潮: A 15 m basalt sea stack that looks like a rhino or dinosaur bending down to drink. A path leads down to the beach; at low tide you can get closer.
附近的 Illugastaðir 有时能看到海豹。: You can sometimes see seals at nearby Illugastaðir.
海边小镇，有超市、加油站和海豹中心。: Seaside village with a supermarket, gas station and seal center.
1 号公路 → 60 号经 Búðardalur → 54 号（部分碎石路）进半: Route 1 → Route 60 via Búðardalur → Route 54 (partly gravel) onto the peninsula's north coast
冰岛出镜率最高的山，前景是小瀑布。可以绕瀑布走一圈。: Iceland's most photographed mountain, with a little waterfall in the foreground. You can walk a loop around the falls.
7 月日落约 23:30，晚上光线最好，可以吃完饭再回来拍。: Sunset is around 23:30 in July and the evening light is best, so you can come back to shoot after dinner.
[[snaefellsnes]] 环半岛 → [[kef]] 还车: [[snaefellsnes]] peninsula loop → return the car at [[kef]]
半岛西端的火山口、黑卵石滩和海岸步道，下午开回凯夫拉维克，晚上还车。: Craters, a black pebble beach and coastal trails at the western tip of the peninsula; drive back to Keflavík in the afternoon and return the car in the evening.
机场附近酒店或青旅，约 18,000–28,000 ISK/间: Hotel or hostel near the airport, about 18,000–28,000 ISK/room
54 号经 Ólafsvík → 574 号绕半岛西端: Route 54 via Ólafsvík → Route 574 around the western tip
约 400 级铁台阶上到火山口边，能看到斯奈山冰川 (Snæfellsjökul: About 400 metal steps up to the crater rim, with views of the Snæfellsjökull glacier and the lava fields.
黑色鹅卵石海滩上散落着 1948 年英国渔船的锈铁残骸。入口有四块「举力石」，以: Rusty wreckage from a British trawler that ran aground in 1948 lies scattered across the black pebbles. At the entrance are four "lifting stones" once used to test fishermen's strength. You can walk over the hill to Dritvík cove and back.
浪很大，不要靠近水边。: Big waves; stay away from the water's edge.
两根巨大的火山颈岩柱立在海边，夏天满是海鸟。: Two huge volcanic plugs standing by the sea, packed with seabirds in summer.
从 Arnarstapi 的巨人 Bárður 雕像和 Gatklettur 拱: Start at the statue of the giant Bárður and the Gatklettur arch in Arnarstapi, walk along the basalt cliffs to Hellnar, have lunch at Fjöruhúsið café by the sea (famous for its fish soup), then walk back.
单程约 2.5 km，往返约 5 km: About 2.5 km one way, 5 km round trip
海崖上有大量三趾鸥 (kittiwake) 筑巢。: Lots of kittiwakes nest on the cliffs.
熔岩原中一座孤零零的黑色小木教堂。: A lone little black wooden church in the middle of a lava field.
路边一整排整齐的玄武岩柱悬崖，停 15 分钟。: A whole roadside cliff of neat basalt columns; stop for 15 min.
54 → 1 号公路经 Borgarnes、Hvalfjörður 隧道（免费）: Route 54 → Route 1 via Borgarnes, the Hvalfjörður tunnel (free) and Reykjavík → Route 41
加油、还 Lotus 车: Fill up, return the Lotus car
加满油、清车、还车: Fill up, clean out and return the car
按合同加满油，清掉车里的垃圾和沙子，还车时绕车拍一圈照片和视频，然后坐接驳车去酒: Fill the tank as per the contract, clear out trash and sand, take photos and video all around the car at drop-off, then take the shuttle to the hotel or airport.
提前跟 Lotus 确认晚上的还车时间和地点。: Confirm the evening drop-off time and place with Lotus in advance.
冰岛酒精很贵，没喝完的也不能带上飞机，可以送给营地的人。: Alcohol is expensive in Iceland and you can't take leftovers on the plane, so give them to people at the campsite.
明早飞卑尔根，要 6 点前到机场。: Flying to Bergen tomorrow morning; be at the airport before 6.
早班机飞卑尔根（比冰岛快 2 小时），下午逛汉萨木屋，傍晚徒步上弗洛伊恩山。: Morning flight to Bergen (2 hours ahead of Iceland); explore the Hanseatic wharf in the afternoon and hike up Mount Fløyen in the early evening.
冰岛和挪威都在申根区，这一段不用过边检，但要带护照。: Iceland and Norway are both in Schengen, so there's no passport control on this leg, but bring your passport.
冰岛航空 KEF→BGO 直飞，飞行约 2 h 20 min（2026 年早班约: Icelandair KEF→BGO direct, about 2 h 20 min (2026 morning flight departs around 08:20–10:10; 2027 schedule TBD); time zone +2 h
今天先不取车，明早在城里取，省一天租金和停车费。: Don't pick up the car today; get it in the city tomorrow morning and save a day of rental and parking.
Bybanen 轻轨 1 号线到市中心 Byparken，约 45 min，Sk: Bybanen light rail line 1 to Byparken downtown, about 45 min; Skyss single ticket (buy in the app)
世界遗产，汉萨同盟时代的彩色木屋码头。从正面拍完后，一定要钻进后面的木头小巷和院: World Heritage Site: the colorful wooden wharf buildings from the Hanseatic era. After the front-on photo, be sure to duck into the wooden alleys and courtyards behind. Drop your bags first.
鱼市很贵，看看就好，或者分一份鱼汤或鱼饼。超市的熟食更划算。: The fish market is pricey, so mostly just look, or share a fish soup or fishcakes. Supermarket deli food is better value.
从 Fløibanen 缆车下站旁的小路徒步上山，约 3 km、爬升约 300: Hike up from the path next to the Fløibanen funicular's lower station, about 3 km and 300 m of climbing; or just take the funicular
山顶观景台俯瞰整个港口和七座山。还有力气可以继续往里走到 Skomakerdik: The summit viewpoint looks over the whole harbor and the seven mountains. If you have energy left, keep going to the little lake Skomakerdiket.
单程约 100 NOK（需核实）: About 100 NOK one way (to be confirmed)
卑尔根一年下雨 200 多天，雨衣放在随手能拿到的地方。: Bergen gets rain over 200 days a year, so keep your rain jacket within easy reach.
在卑尔根取车，沿哈当厄尔峡湾开到奥达，下午走布尔冰川步道，为明天恶魔之舌养精蓄锐: Pick up the car in Bergen, drive along the Hardangerfjord to Odda, hike the Buerbreen glacier trail in the afternoon, and rest up for Trolltunga tomorrow.
营地或小木屋（Odda / Tyssedal），营地约 250–400 NOK/: Campsite or cabin (Odda / Tyssedal), campsites about 250–400 NOK/person; hostels and hotels around Trolltunga cost more
在城里的租车点取车，约好 7/21 在机场还车。路上的电子收费 (AutoPAS: Pick up the car at a city rental office and arrange to return it at the airport on Jul 21. The rental company charges electronic road tolls (AutoPASS) afterwards.
步道可以绕到瀑布水帘后面，从里往外看。: The path loops behind the curtain of water so you can look out from inside.
7 号公路沿峡湾北岸 → 哈当厄尔大桥 (Hardangerbrua) → 13: Route 7 along the north shore of the fjord → Hardanger Bridge (Hardangerbrua) → Route 13 south along Sørfjorden via Kinsarvik and Lofthus
去 Rema 1000 / Coop 买明天的午餐、零食和水。: Buy tomorrow's lunch, snacks and water at Rema 1000 / Coop.
7 月是哈当厄尔的樱桃季，路边果园小摊有现摘的樱桃和苹果汁。: July is cherry season in Hardanger; roadside orchard stands sell freshly picked cherries and apple juice.
Buer 山谷小路: Narrow road up the Buer valley
Folgefonna 冰盖垂下来的一条冰川舌。沿河谷走过草地和石坡，最后一段有铁: A glacier tongue spilling down from the Folgefonna ice cap. The trail crosses meadows and rocky slopes up the valley, with chains and ladders on the last stretch, to a viewpoint in front of the glacier. Don't go onto the ice.
明天要走 10 小时，累的话就跳过，在奥达休息，或者只去看 Låtefossen: Tomorrow is a 10-hour hike; if you're tired, skip this and rest in Odda, or just go see the Låtefossen twin waterfall (about 20 min south).
明早 5:30 起床，今晚把背包、头灯、水准备好。: Up at 5:30 tomorrow; get your pack, headlamp and water ready tonight.
挪威最有名的徒步之一：从 P3 往返约 20 km，站上悬在湖面 700 m 高: One of Norway's most famous hikes: about 20 km round trip from P3 to stand on the "Troll's Tongue", 700 m above the lake.
同前一晚（奥达），连住两晚: Same as last night (Odda), two nights in a row
看一眼天气和 Trolltunga 官方的路况与安全提示，大雾或暴雨就改天或请向: Check the weather and Trolltunga's official trail and safety updates; in thick fog or heavy rain, go another day or hire a guide.
经 Tyssedal 上 Skjeggedal 山路，窄而陡: Via Tyssedal up the Skjeggedal mountain road, narrow and steep
P2 → P3 的单车道私人收费路，约 7 km；没订到 P3 就停 P2，坐接: P2 → P3 is a single-lane private toll road, about 7 km; if you didn't get a P3 slot, park at P2 and take the shuttle (about 150–200 NOK) or walk an extra 4 km
按预约时间停车，入口看一眼路线标志和最晚折返时间。: Park at your reserved time; at the trailhead check the route signs and the latest turnaround time.
红色 T 标记，起伏的高原路线，单程约 10 km: Red T markers, rolling plateau route, about 10 km one way
悬在 Ringedalsvatnet 湖面上方约 700 m 的一块平石舌。夏天: A flat tongue of rock jutting out about 700 m above the lake Ringedalsvatnet. In summer the photo queue is often 30–90 min, so find a rock and have lunch first.
从 P3 约 20 km / 8–10 h；从 P2 约 27 km / 10–: About 20 km / 8–10 h from P3; about 27 km / 10–12 h from P2
带 2–3 L 水（沿途溪水可补）、头灯、保暖层和防水外套。: Bring 2–3 L of water (you can refill from streams), a headlamp, a warm layer and a waterproof jacket.
7 月初高处可能还有残雪，穿抓地好的徒步鞋。: There may still be snow up high in early July; wear hiking shoes with good grip.
下午 1 点前必须往回走（以官方折返时间为准）。: You must turn back by 1 pm (follow the official turnaround time).
今晚可以在奥达吃顿热饭犒劳自己。: Treat yourself to a hot meal in Odda tonight.
一路看瀑布：挪威最出名的沃林瀑布、路边的特温德瀑布，再从斯塔尔海姆俯瞰纳柔依山谷: Waterfalls all day: Vøringsfossen, Norway's most famous; Tvindefossen by the roadside; then the view over the Nærøy valley from Stalheim, reaching Flåm by early evening.
Flåm Camping & Hostel，营地约 300 NOK/人，床位约: Flåm Camping & Hostel, camping about 300 NOK/person, beds about 450–600 NOK (book early, very popular)
腿可能还酸，今天主要是开车和短距离步行。: Your legs may still be sore; today is mostly driving and short walks.
13 号公路北上到 Brimnes → 7 号公路经 Eidfjord，上 Må: Route 13 north to Brimnes → Route 7 via Eidfjord, up the Måbødalen valley
落差 163 m 的大瀑布。2020 年新建的阶梯桥横跨峡谷，可以从不同高度看瀑: A huge waterfall with a 163 m drop. A stair bridge built across the gorge in 2020 lets you see it from different heights, and there's the classic viewpoint in front of the Fossli Hotel.
7 号公路回 Eidfjord → 哈当厄尔大桥 → 13 号公路经 Granv: Route 7 back to Eidfjord → Hardanger Bridge → Route 13 via Granvin and Voss → E16
路边阶梯状的大瀑布，旁边有营地，可以野餐。: A big tiered waterfall by the road, with a campsite next to it where you can picnic.
Stalheim 酒店后院的观景台能看到 U 形的 Nærøydalen 山谷。: The viewpoint behind the Stalheim Hotel looks down the U-shaped Nærøydalen valley. Next to it, Stalheimskleiva is one of Norway's steepest roads (13 hairpin bends).
Stalheimskleiva 有时因落石封闭，开不了就走 E16 隧道。: Stalheimskleiva is sometimes closed for rockfall; if so, take the E16 tunnel.
E16 经 Gudvangen 隧道（11.4 km）: E16 through the Gudvangen tunnel (11.4 km)
弗洛姆村很小，白天有邮轮，傍晚游客走了就安静了。超市 Coop 在火车站旁边。: Flåm is tiny; cruise ships bring crowds by day, but it goes quiet once they leave in the evening. The Coop supermarket is next to the train station.
从村子往山谷里走，过农场后开始陡坡: Walk from the village into the valley; it gets steep after the farm
爬坡看瀑布和峡湾: Climb up for the waterfall and fjord
很陡但很短的小路，上面能同时看到瀑布和弗洛姆峡湾。: A very steep but short path; from the top you see the waterfall and the Flåm fjord together.
坐电动游船穿过世界遗产纳柔依峡湾，下午开上 650 m 高的观景台和夏天才开放的: Take an electric boat through the World Heritage Nærøyfjord, then drive up to a 650 m viewpoint and the summer-only Snow Road in the afternoon.
同前一晚（弗洛姆），连住两晚: Same as last night (Flåm), two nights in a row
提前 20 分钟到码头。: Be at the pier 20 min early.
The Fjords 电动游船（Future/Vision of the Fjo: The Fjords electric boat (Future/Vision of the Fjords), Flåm → Gudvangen about 2 h, through the Aurlandsfjord into the Nærøyfjord; summer 2025 one-way fare 640 NOK, 2027 times and fares TBD
在峡湾尽头走走: Stroll at the end of the fjord
峡湾尽头的小村子，两边是上千米高的峭壁和瀑布。旁边的维京村 Njardarhei: A little village at the end of the fjord, with thousand-meter cliffs and waterfalls on both sides. The Viking village Njardarheimr next door needs a separate ticket; optional.
巴士回弗洛姆（约 20 分钟，常与游船配套卖票）: Bus back to Flåm (about 20 min, often sold together with the boat ticket)
Ægir 啤酒馆很有特色但贵，自己做三明治更省钱。: The Ægir brewpub is fun but pricey; making your own sandwiches is cheaper.
经 Aurland 上 243 号公路 (Aurlandsfjellet)，窄而: Via Aurland up Route 243 (Aurlandsfjellet), narrow with lots of hairpins
伸出悬崖 30 m 的木头观景台，离峡湾面约 650 m，俯瞰 Aurlands: A wooden platform jutting 30 m out from the cliff, about 650 m above the fjord, looking over the Aurlandsfjord.
继续走 243 号上高原（夏季开放，约 6–10 月）: Continue on Route 243 up to the plateau (open in summer, roughly Jun–Oct)
林木线以上的高原，7 月路边常有几米高的雪墙和融雪湖。在国家风景路线的休息点下车: A plateau above the tree line; in July there are often snow walls several meters high and meltwater lakes by the road. Stop at the National Tourist Route rest areas and wander around.
明天中午前要到卑尔根机场还车。: The car needs to be back at Bergen Airport before noon tomorrow.
备选（有一项特别想做时）：坐弗洛姆铁路 (Flåmsbana) 上 Myrdal: Alternative (if there's one thing you really want to do): take the Flåm Railway (Flåmsbana) up to Myrdal, rent a bike and ride 20 km downhill along the Rallarvegen back to Flåm, about half a day.
上午开回卑尔根机场还车，下午直飞斯德哥尔摩，晚上逛老城。: Drive back to Bergen Airport in the morning to return the car, direct flight to Stockholm in the afternoon, evening in the old town.
留足时间，路上可能遇到修路和羊群。: Allow plenty of time; you may hit roadworks and flocks of sheep.
E16 经 Gudvangen、Voss，过 Bergen 环城收费后去 Fle: E16 via Gudvangen and Voss, through the Bergen ring-road toll, then to Flesland Airport
机场附近加油站加满油，还车时拍照。: Fill up at a gas station near the airport and take photos when you return the car.
SAS / Norwegian 直飞约 1 h 20 min，具体航班和时间待定: SAS / Norwegian direct, about 1 h 20 min; flight and times TBD
Arlanda Express 18 分钟（贵）/ SL 通勤火车经 Arlan: Arlanda Express 18 min (pricey) / SL commuter train via Arlanda C about 40 min (cheap, but there's an airport station fee) / Flygbussarna airport bus about 45 min
去游客中心或 SL app 买 72 小时交通卡，三天都能用。: Buy a 72-hour transit pass at the visitor center or in the SL app; it covers all three days.
傍晚游客少，石板巷子很好看。晚饭可以吃瑞典肉丸。: Fewer tourists in the evening and the cobbled lanes look lovely. Try Swedish meatballs for dinner.
市政厅塔楼、老城和王宫卫兵换岗、瓦萨沉船博物馆、斯堪森露天博物馆，傍晚在南岛看日: City Hall tower, the old town and the changing of the guard at the Royal Palace, the Vasa Museum, Skansen open-air museum, then sunset on Södermalm.
步行或地铁到 Rådhuset 站: Walk or metro to Rådhuset station
登塔看全城: Up the tower for city views
诺贝尔奖晚宴在这里的蓝厅举行。塔楼高 106 m，能看到老城和梅拉伦湖。: The Nobel Prize banquet is held in the Blue Hall here. The 106 m tower looks out over the old town and Lake Mälaren.
塔楼约 90–150 SEK（需核实），限时段，现场或网上买: Tower about 90–150 SEK (to be confirmed), timed slots, buy on site or online
过桥进老城: Over the bridge into the old town
Stortorget 广场上的彩色山墙房、只有 90 cm 宽的 Mårten: The colorful gabled houses on Stortorget, Mårten Trotzigs gränd (only 90 cm wide), and the cathedral.
看卫兵换岗: Watching the changing of the guard
夏天大约中午 12:15 开始（周日 13:15），在外院看，免费。: Starts around 12:15 in summer (13:15 on Sundays); watch from the outer courtyard, free.
找挂「Dagens lunch」牌子的餐馆，约 130–160 SEK，含沙拉、: Look for restaurants with a "Dagens lunch" sign, about 130–160 SEK including salad, bread and coffee.
Slussen 坐 Djurgårdsfärjan 渡轮到动物园岛，SL 交通卡: Djurgårdsfärjan ferry from Slussen to Djurgården; SL pass valid
首航 20 分钟就沉没的皇家战舰，98% 是原件，在海底躺了 333 年。: A royal warship that sank 20 minutes into its maiden voyage; 98% original, after 333 years on the seabed.
成人约 230 SEK，学生有优惠（需核实）: Adults about 230 SEK, student discount available (to be confirmed)
世界上第一个露天博物馆：从全国搬来的老农舍和手工作坊，还有北欧动物园，能看到驼鹿: The world's first open-air museum: old farmhouses and craft workshops moved here from all over Sweden, plus a Nordic zoo with moose, bears and wolverines.
随季节变化，约 200–300 SEK（需核实）: Varies by season, about 200–300 SEK (to be confirmed)
预算紧可以跳过，改去免费的 Rosendals 花园喝下午茶。: On a tight budget, skip it and have afternoon tea at the free Rosendals garden instead.
7 号电车 + 地铁到 Slussen，步行上坡: Tram 7 + metro to Slussen, then walk uphill
南岛 (Södermalm) 崖边的小步道，正对市政厅和骑士岛。附近有很多便宜的: A little clifftop path on Södermalm facing City Hall and Riddarholmen. Lots of cheap restaurants nearby.
地铁回住处: Metro back to where you're staying
上午看「世界上最长的美术馆」地铁站，中午坐船进群岛，到木屋小镇瓦克斯霍尔姆。: Morning at the metro stations of "the world's longest art gallery", then a boat out into the archipelago at midday to the wooden-house town of Vaxholm.
蓝线 T-Centralen 的藤蔓图案、Kungsträdgården 的洞穴: The vine patterns at T-Centralen on the blue line, the excavation-site cave at Kungsträdgården, the red forest at Solna Centrum, the rainbow at Stadion. Ride as much as you like on your pass.
步行到大酒店前的码头: Walk to the pier in front of the Grand Hôtel
Waxholmsbolaget 群岛船约 1 h，在群岛间穿行；单程约 90 S: Waxholmsbolaget archipelago boat, about 1 h weaving between the islands; about 90 SEK one way (to be confirmed; SL passes usually not valid)
彩色木屋、海边步道、小码头。可以坐 5 分钟小船去对岸 16 世纪的瓦克斯霍尔姆: Colorful wooden houses, a waterfront path and little piers. Take the 5-minute boat across to the 16th-century Vaxholm Fortress, then find a café for fika (coffee + cinnamon bun).
坐船回城（或 670 路巴士约 50 min，可用 SL 卡）: Boat back to the city (or bus 670, about 50 min, SL pass valid)
南岛有很多二手店、咖啡馆和便宜的餐馆。Fotografiska 摄影博物馆开到很: Södermalm is full of secondhand shops, cafés and cheap restaurants. The Fotografiska photography museum stays open late; optional.
通勤火车去尼奈斯港，坐 3 小时渡轮到中世纪城墙小城维斯比，傍晚逛古城。: Commuter train to Nynäshamn, a 3-hour ferry to the medieval walled town of Visby, and an evening stroll through the old town.
青旅或民宿，旺季约 500–900 SEK/人: Hostel or guesthouse, about 500–900 SEK/person in peak season
退房、去车站: Check out, head to the station
SL 通勤火车 (pendeltåg) 从 Stockholm City 到 N: SL commuter train (pendeltåg) from Stockholm City to Nynäshamn, about 1 h, SL ticket valid; or take the ferry company's bus (from Cityterminalen)
步行乘客通常要在开船前约 20–30 分钟到码头。: Foot passengers usually need to be at the terminal about 20–30 min before departure.
Destination Gotland，约 3 h 15 min（2026 年夏: Destination Gotland, about 3 h 15 min (summer 2026 reference departures 11:25 / 14:10 / 20:10; 2027 schedule TBD)
城墙边的公园和水池。每年 6 月底的政治周就在这里，但我们来的时候已经结束。: A park with ponds next to the city wall. Almedalen Week, the political festival, is held here every late June, but it'll be over by the time we arrive.
大广场上 13 世纪的圣卡琳教堂废墟没有屋顶。往海边走，Fiskargränd: The 13th-century St Karin church ruin on the main square has no roof. Toward the sea, lanes like Fiskargränd are covered in roses.
古城里唯一还在用的中世纪教堂，三座黑色尖塔。: The only medieval church in the old town still in use, with three black spires.
3.4 km 长的中世纪城墙，还保留着 27 座塔楼。从城墙外的草地绕一圈，最后: A 3.4 km medieval wall with 27 towers still standing. Loop around on the meadows outside the wall and end up back at the sea.
7 月下旬日落约 21:30，晚饭后去海边看日落。: Sunset is around 21:30 in late July; head to the waterfront after dinner to watch it.
试试哥特兰的特色甜点：番红花布丁配黑莓酱 (saffranspannkaka)。: Try Gotland's signature dessert: saffron pancake with blackberry jam (saffranspannkaka).
自驾 [[faro]]：海蚀柱和白沙滩: Drive to [[faro]]: sea stacks and white sand beaches
租车去哥特兰最北边的弗罗岛，看石灰岩海蚀柱 (raukar)、在波罗的海游泳，回: Rent a car to Fårö at Gotland's northern tip, see the limestone sea stacks (raukar), swim in the Baltic, and stop at the Jungfrun rauk on the way back.
[[visby]] 取租车: Pick up a rental car in [[visby]]
在港口附近的租车公司取车（7 月要提前订）。: Pick up the car from a rental company near the harbor (book ahead for July).
免费汽车渡轮约 8 分钟，班次很密，夏天可能要排队: Free car ferry, about 8 min, very frequent; there may be a queue in summer
岛西岸小路: Small road along the island's west coast
西海岸一长排灰白色的石灰岩柱，可以沿砾石滩一路走过去。: A long row of pale grey limestone stacks on the west coast; you can walk along the shingle beach past them all.
岛北部小路: Small road across the north of the island
弗罗岛最有名的海蚀柱群，造型最奇特。电影导演伯格曼 (Ingmar Bergma: Fårö's most famous group of sea stacks, with the strangest shapes. Film director Ingmar Bergman lived on this island in his later years.
细白沙滩，波罗的海 7 月下旬水温约 18–20°C。: Fine white sand; the Baltic is about 18–20 °C in late July.
走 149 号公路沿西海岸回程: Route 149 back along the west coast
立在海崖边、高约 26 m 的海蚀柱，旁边是小渔港 Lickershamn。: A sea stack about 26 m tall at the edge of the cliff, next to the little fishing harbor of Lickershamn.
还车、回住处: Return the car, back to your stay
骑车去 [[hogklint]] + 古城慢游: Cycle to [[hogklint]] + slow wander through the old town
骑车沿海岸去南边的赫格克林特海崖，下午看维京图石、逛植物园，傍晚走北边的绞刑台山: Cycle south along the coast to the Högklint cliffs, see Viking picture stones and the botanical garden in the afternoon, and walk Galgberget to the north in the early evening.
维斯比租车点很多，一天约 150–250 SEK。: Visby has plenty of bike rental shops, about 150–250 SEK a day.
骑车约 30–45 min（约 8 km，沿海岸经 Fridhem）: About 30–45 min by bike (about 8 km along the coast via Fridhem)
48 m 高的石灰岩海崖，能俯瞰海和维斯比古城。崖顶有森林小路，可以往南一直走到: A 48 m limestone cliff overlooking the sea and Visby's old town. Forest paths on top lead south all the way to Fridhem.
看维京图石和银器宝藏: Viking picture stones and silver hoards
哥特兰出土的维京时代银币和窖藏比北欧任何地方都多，还有一屋子雕花的图像石。: More Viking-age silver coins and hoards have been found on Gotland than anywhere else in the Nordics, plus a whole room of carved picture stones.
免费的海边植物园，里面有教堂废墟和很多玫瑰。: Free seaside botanical garden with a church ruin and lots of roses.
出北门沿海边往北: Out the north gate and north along the sea
中世纪的绞刑台石柱，旁边是海崖上的松林步道，能远眺维斯比。: Medieval gallows pillars next to a pine-forest trail along the cliffs, with views back to Visby.
原路返回、还车: Back the same way, return the bikes
明早坐早班渡轮，今晚把行李收好。: Early ferry tomorrow morning, so pack tonight.
渡轮回瑞典本土，汽车到卡尔马看城堡，再坐火车穿过厄勒海峡大桥到哥本哈根。: Ferry back to the Swedish mainland, bus to Kalmar for the castle, then a train over the Øresund Bridge to Copenhagen.
退房、去码头: Check out, head to the ferry
Destination Gotland 维斯比 → 奥斯卡港约 3 h（每天约: Destination Gotland Visby → Oskarshamn, about 3 h (about 1–2 sailings a day; 2027 schedule TBD, adjust the day's plan to the actual times)
Kalmar Länstrafik 区域巴士约 1 h 20 min（或按时刻表: Kalmar Länstrafik regional bus, about 1 h 20 min (or train, depending on the timetable)
1397 年卡尔马联盟签订的地方，护城河环绕的文艺复兴城堡，在城墙边的公园吃午饭: Where the Kalmar Union was signed in 1397: a moated Renaissance castle. Have lunch in the park by the walls.
约 150–200 SEK（只看外观免费，需核实）: About 150–200 SEK (free to see from outside; to be confirmed)
Öresundståg 约 4 h（经 Växjö、Hässleholm、Mal: Öresundståg about 4 h (via Växjö, Hässleholm and Malmö, over the Øresund Bridge), roughly every 2 h; you may need to change in Malmö. There may be ID checks entering Denmark
买张 City Pass 或用 DOT app 买票，市区地铁和火车都能用。: Get a City Pass or buy tickets in the DOT app; valid on the city metro and trains.
像本地人一样骑车：王宫、圆塔、免费的议会塔楼、新港运河，晚上去蒂沃利。: Cycle like a local: the royal palace, the Round Tower, the free parliament tower, the Nyhavn canal, and Tivoli in the evening.
玻璃顶的美食市场，来个丹麦面包 (wienerbrød) 或开放三明治 (smø: A glass-roofed food market; grab a Danish pastry (wienerbrød) or an open sandwich (smørrebrød).
骑车或步行（租车用 Donkey Republic 等 app，一天约 100–: Bike or walk (rent bikes with apps like Donkey Republic, about 100–150 DKK a day)
童话般的文艺复兴宫殿，地下室收着丹麦王冠珠宝。花园免费，宫殿要买票。: A fairytale Renaissance palace with the Danish crown jewels in the basement. The garden is free; the palace needs a ticket.
17 世纪的天文台，里面不是楼梯，而是 209 m 长的螺旋坡道。: A 17th-century observatory with a 209 m spiral ramp inside instead of stairs.
议会大楼的塔楼可以免费上，是市中心最高的观景台，塔顶有餐厅。: The parliament building's tower is free to climb and is the highest viewpoint in the city center, with a restaurant at the top.
彩色房子的老港口。坐 1 小时运河游船，能看到小美人鱼、歌剧院和克里斯蒂安港。: The old harbor lined with colorful houses. A 1-hour canal cruise takes in the Little Mermaid, the Opera House and Christianshavn.
新港餐厅很贵，在码头边买个热狗就好。: Nyhavn's restaurants are expensive; just grab a hot dog on the quay.
1971 年起的嬉皮自治社区，有壁画、手作房屋和湖边小路。: A self-governing hippie community since 1971, with murals, handmade houses and lakeside paths.
Pusher Street 一带禁止拍照，尊重当地规矩。: No photos around Pusher Street; respect the local rules.
骑车去中央车站对面，还车: Cycle to the area across from Central Station and return the bikes
1843 年开的老游乐园，晚上亮灯后最美。只买门票逛园子也够，机动游戏另外付费。: An old amusement park opened in 1843, at its most beautiful when the lights come on at night. An entry ticket is enough to wander the gardens; rides cost extra.
约 150–200 DKK，游乐设施另算（需核实）: About 150–200 DKK, rides extra (to be confirmed)
坐沿海铁路北上：上午在海边的路易斯安那现代艺术博物馆，下午去哈姆雷特的克伦堡宫。: Take the coastal railway north: the seaside Louisiana Museum of Modern Art in the morning, Hamlet's Kronborg Castle in the afternoon.
买到 Helsingør 的往返票，或者买可以中途下车的车票。: Buy a return ticket to Helsingør, or a ticket that lets you stop off on the way.
沿海铁路 (Kystbanen) 到 Humlebæk 约 40 min，再步行: Coastal railway (Kystbanen) to Humlebæk, about 40 min, then about a 10 min walk
看展、在海边草坪野餐: Exhibitions and a picnic on the seaside lawn
建在海边的现代艺术博物馆，有贾科梅蒂、草间弥生等人的作品，雕塑公园正对厄勒海峡和: A modern art museum by the sea, with works by Giacometti, Yayoi Kusama and others; the sculpture park looks across the Øresund to Sweden.
约 165 DKK，学生有优惠（需核实）: About 165 DKK, student discount available (to be confirmed)
Humlebæk → Helsingør 约 10 min，再步行约 15 mi: Humlebæk → Helsingør about 10 min, then about a 15 min walk
莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》中艾尔西诺城堡的原型，世界遗产。别错过地下暗堡和沉睡的勇士霍: The model for Elsinore in Shakespeare's Hamlet, and a World Heritage Site. Don't miss the casemates and the statue of the sleeping hero Holger Danske.
旁边由废弃船坞改建的海事博物馆 (M/S Museet for Søfart): Next door, the Maritime Museum (M/S Museet for Søfart), built into an old dry dock, is famous for its architecture.
渡轮 20 分钟就能到瑞典的赫尔辛堡 (Helsingborg)。: It's only a 20-minute ferry to Helsingborg in Sweden.
自驾 [[stevns_klint]] + [[mons_klint]] 白垩海: Drive to the chalk cliffs of [[stevns_klint]] + [[mons_klint]]
租一天车往南：先看世界遗产斯泰温斯崖和半塌的老教堂，再去默恩崖走海滩和崖顶森林。: Rent a car for a day and head south: first Stevns Klint, a World Heritage Site, and its half-collapsed old church, then Møns Klint for the beach and the clifftop forest.
城里或机场取车，一天约 500–700 DKK。: Pick up the car in the city or at the airport, about 500–700 DKK a day.
看白垩崖和半塌的教堂: Chalk cliff and the half-collapsed church
世界遗产海崖，岩层里清楚地留着 6,600 万年前恐龙灭绝的那层「鱼黏土」。霍耶: World Heritage sea cliffs where you can clearly see the "fish clay" layer marking the dinosaur extinction 66 million years ago. Part of Højerup Old Church has already fallen into the sea.
南下经 E47 → 亚历山德琳王后大桥 (Dronning Alexandrin: South via the E47 → Queen Alexandrine Bridge (Dronning Alexandrines Bro) onto Møn, via Stege
下到海滩、走崖顶步道: Down to the beach, back along the clifftop trail
128 m 高的白色白垩崖。先逛 GeoCenter 博物馆，再走约 500 级: White chalk cliffs 128 m high. Visit the GeoCenter museum first, then take about 500 wooden steps down to the beach, walk along the shore looking at the cliffs and fossils, climb another staircase back up and return through the beech forest.
约 150–200 DKK（只走步道免费，需核实）: About 150–200 DKK (trails are free; to be confirmed)
海滩是碎石和燧石，穿徒步鞋。: The beach is gravel and flint, so wear hiking shoes.
下雨后台阶和崖边很滑。: The steps and cliff edges are slippery after rain.
E47 / E20 北上回城: E47 / E20 north back to the city
不租车的话：火车到 Vordingborg + 巴士经 Stege 到默恩崖（夏: Without a car: train to Vordingborg + bus via Stege to Møns Klint (summer service), about 2.5–3 h each way, and you'd have to skip Stevns Klint.
[[dyrehaven]] 鹿园徒步 + 自由日 + [[reffen]]: Deer park hike in [[dyrehaven]] + free day + [[reffen]]
上午去郊外的鹿园看野鹿和猎宫，下午买手信、收拾行李，晚上在雷芬吃告别晚餐。: Morning in the deer park outside the city to see wild deer and the hunting lodge; afternoon for souvenirs and packing; farewell dinner at Reffen in the evening.
S-tog C 线到 Klampenborg 约 20 min，再步行进园: S-tog line C to Klampenborg, about 20 min, then walk into the park
皇家狩猎林，世界遗产，林子里有 2,000 多头梅花鹿和马鹿，小山顶上是白色的猎: A royal hunting forest and World Heritage Site, home to over 2,000 fallow and red deer, with the white hunting lodge (Eremitagen) on a hilltop. Next to the entrance is Bakken, an old amusement park opened in 1583, free to enter.
步行街和周边小店。离境退税：非欧盟居民在同一家店当天消费满一定金额可以退税，要保: The pedestrian street and the shops around it. Tax-free refund: non-EU residents can claim a VAT refund when spending over a set amount in one shop on one day; keep the receipts.
旧船厂改的海边街头美食市场，几十个小摊，看着日落干杯。: A seaside street food market in an old shipyard, with dozens of stalls. Raise a glass to the sunset.
退房，坐地铁去机场，直飞回多伦多。: Check out, metro to the airport, direct flight home to Toronto.
无（当天飞回多伦多）: None (flying back to Toronto that day)
地铁 M2 线或 DSB 火车从中央车站到机场，约 15 分钟: Metro line M2 or DSB train from Central Station to the airport, about 15 min
退税先到 Global Blue / Planet 柜台。离开申根区要过边检，出: Go to the Global Blue / Planet counter first for tax refunds. Leaving Schengen means passport control, where you'll be registered in the Entry/Exit System (EES).
SAS 或加航直飞约 8.5 h（多伦多比丹麦晚 6 小时）；具体航班和时间以出: SAS or Air Canada direct, about 8.5 h (Toronto is 6 hours behind Denmark); exact flight and times as ticketed
订多城市票。CPH→YYZ 有 SAS 和加航直飞。中国护照持有人要先拿到机票行: Book a multi-city ticket. SAS and Air Canada fly CPH→YYZ direct. Chinese passport holders need the flight itinerary before they can apply for the visa.
申根签证（中国护照）：在 VFS 多伦多递交冰岛签证: Schengen visa (Chinese passport): apply for an Iceland visa at VFS Toronto
2027-01-04 起可以递交（入境前 6 个月），建议 1–3 月递交；最晚: Applications open 2027-01-04 (6 months before entry); apply Jan–Mar ideally; no later than 15 days before entry
冰岛停留 12 晚，是停留最长的国家，所以申请冰岛签证；在加拿大由 VFS 多伦: Iceland is the longest stay (12 nights), so apply for an Iceland visa. In Canada, VFS Toronto/Ottawa/Vancouver accept applications, which are sent to the Embassy of Iceland in Washington for processing.
提前准备好可免费取消的住宿预订和机票行程单；VFS 暑假前预约紧张，1 月就去约: Have free-cancellation accommodation bookings and the flight itinerary ready in advance; VFS appointments fill up before summer, so book one in January.
确认加拿大学签/工签 + TRV 在 2027-11 之后仍有效: Confirm your Canadian study/work permit + TRV are still valid after 2027-11
填写冰岛申根签证申请表: Fill in the Iceland Schengen visa application form
准备材料：护照、照片、行程、机票、住宿、保险、近 3 个月银行流水、在读证明: Gather documents: passport, photos, itinerary, flights, accommodation, insurance, last 3 months of bank statements, proof of enrollment
现场录指纹、交费: Give fingerprints and pay in person
冰岛外交部公告: Iceland Ministry for Foreign Affairs notice
中国护照持有人：检查加拿大 TRV（访客签证）有效期: Chinese passport holders: check your Canadian TRV (visitor visa) expiry
现在就查；需要续签就马上申请: Check now; if it needs renewing, apply right away
CAD 100（TRV 申请费，需核实）: CAD 100 (TRV application fee, to be confirmed)
学签本身不能用来入境加拿大，回多伦多时需要有效的 TRV 或 PR 卡；冰岛的签: A study permit alone doesn't let you re-enter Canada; you need a valid TRV or PR card to get back into Toronto. Iceland's visa checklist also requires it to be valid for at least 3 months after you return to Canada.
回到加拿大后仍有效 ≥3 个月（冰岛清单）: Valid ≥ 3 months after returning to Canada (Iceland checklist)
IRCC 审理可能要几周到几个月，必须在递交申根签证前办好。: IRCC processing can take weeks to months; it must be done before you apply for the Schengen visa.
看护照里 TRV 签证页的到期日: Check the expiry date on the TRV page in your passport
如果早于约 2027-11，在 IRCC 网上续签: If it's earlier than about 2027-11, renew online with IRCC
拿到新签证页后再约 VFS: Book VFS once you have the new visa page
IRCC 在加拿大境内申请访客签证: IRCC: apply for a visitor visa from inside Canada
越早越好；7 月四驱车紧张，建议提前 6–9 个月订（经验建议，未核实）: The sooner the better; 4x4s are scarce in July, so book 6–9 months ahead (rule of thumb, not verified)
看车型和保险；另按公里收道路税 6.95 ISK/km: Depends on model and insurance; plus a road tax of 6.95 ISK/km
至少 SUV、四驱，全险必须买。要开 F208/F225，所以要 Lotus 标: At least an SUV with 4WD, and full insurance is a must. You'll drive F208/F225, so you need a car Lotus marks as "F-road approved", with Platinum: it's the only tier that covers water damage. Pick up at [[kef]] and return at [[kef]], so no one-way fee.
Platinum（自付额 0，含涉水和 F 路）: Platinum (deductible 0, covers river crossings and F-roads)
预订时说明要开 F208/F225。只有 Platinum 含涉水保护和 F 路: Say you'll be driving F208/F225 when booking. Only Platinum includes river-crossing protection and F-road cover; Krossá (F249) is never covered.
按 2026 年推测 4 月 1 日开放，开放当天就订: Based on 2026, bookings likely open Apr 1; book on opening day
6/20–9/13 期间，9:00–16:00 之间开车到达必须预约；露营也要另: From Jun 20 to Sep 13, arriving by car between 9:00 and 16:00 requires a reservation; camping is booked separately (the campsite is a different system). About 140 slots a day; in 2024 they sold out almost every day.
入住、离开日期和车牌: Arrival and departure dates and license plate
到达前 7 天以上可改: Can be changed 7+ days before arrival
开放日期是按 2026 年推测的，2027 年 3 月去 ust.is 确认。: The opening date is a guess based on 2026; confirm on ust.is in March 2027.
FÍ 开放 2027 年预订的日期未核实，开放就订: When FÍ opens 2027 bookings is not confirmed; book as soon as it opens
必须预订，每单最多 6 人。高地夜里接近 0 °C，要带四季帐和零度睡袋。: Booking required, max 6 people per booking. Highland nights get close to 0 °C, so bring a four-season tent and a 0-degree sleeping bag.
现在到 2027 年 1 月；维克和 Smyrlabjörg 最先满: Between now and January 2027; Vík and Smyrlabjörg fill up first
7/6 住营地，其余 5 晚要订房。: Jul 6 is at the campsite; the other 5 nights need rooms booked.
雷克雅未克选有停车位的；Hella 也可换成更靠近高地的 Hrauneyjar: In Reykjavík pick a place with parking; instead of Hella you could stay at the Hrauneyjar Highland Center, closer to the Highlands.
现在到 2027 年 1 月订；米湖和斯奈山半岛的房间最少: Book between now and January 2027; Mývatn and Snæfellsnes have the fewest rooms
这 5 晚都住房间（民宿、青旅或酒店）。米湖和斯奈山半岛的房间很少，7 月很早就: All 5 nights are in rooms (guesthouse, hostel or hotel). Mývatn and Snæfellsnes have very few rooms and sell out early for July. For Jul 15, book somewhere near the airport with a shuttle, to make returning the car and catching the early flight easy.
订有机场接送的酒店或青旅: Book a hotel or hostel with an airport shuttle
先订可免费取消的，签证材料也用得上。: Book free-cancellation options first; you can use them for the visa application too.
签证递交前买好（可以买出发后才生效的保单）: Buy before applying for the visa (you can buy a policy that only starts on departure)
约 CAD 80–200/人（4 周，需核实）: About CAD 80–200/person (4 weeks, to be confirmed)
签证必须提供；加拿大护照持有人也强烈建议买。学校的 UHIP 或学生保险一般不覆: Required for the visa, and strongly recommended for Canadian passport holders too. University UHIP or student insurance usually doesn't cover travel abroad, or the coverage isn't high enough.
确认保单包含徒步、冰川徒步这类户外活动。: Make sure the policy covers outdoor activities like hiking and glacier hiking.
等欧盟公布启用日期；如果启用了，出发前 1 个月申请: Wait for the EU to announce the launch date; if it's live, apply 1 month before departure
原定 2026 年第 4 季度启用，2026 年 7 月官网撤下了这个时间，目前: Originally set to launch in Q4 2026, but the official site removed that date in July 2026; there's no official date now, and most expect 2027. There should be a transition period of a few months after launch when it isn't mandatory.
3 年或护照到期: 3 years or until your passport expires
只在欧盟官网申请，第三方代办网站会多收钱。: Only apply on the official EU site; third-party sites charge extra.
